decision_rules.not_identifiable: response below residual/quantization uncertainty; no Batch B
decision_rules.penalty: phase identifiable but projector worsens; Batch B only with measured W/D/Psi compensation
decision_rules.redundant: response within existing span within residual envelope; no Batch B
decision_rules.validated: J2_length response exceeds residual envelope and has component outside W/D/Psi span
